# CORE-OPS-02

**Can the running design be observed through logs, metrics, traces and an audit trail, to stated conventions?**

| | |
|---|---|
| Lens | [Core architecture lens](core.md) 0.6.0 |
| Area | OPS: Operability |
| Default severity | major |
| Decided by | A tool, by its rule |
| Applies when | design.type is reference-architecture or solution-design |
| Reads | `operations.observability` |

## Rule

logs, metrics and traces are all true, and conventions names the conventions the telemetry follows, such as the OpenTelemetry semantic conventions, or, on a managed platform, the platform's telemetry schema and where it is sent. A conventions value that names only a product or a destination is partly-met.

## Sources

- AWS Well-Architected Framework (`wa-aws`)
- OpenTelemetry semantic conventions (`otel`)
